content.text:
This is ebselen: a benzisoselenazolone with an N-phenyl group.

- The five-membered ring contains C(=O), N, Se, and two fused aromatic carbons.
- The carbonyl carbon is attached to the benzo ring and to N.
- N carries the phenyl group and is bonded to Se.
- Se is bonded to the benzo ring.

SMILES: O=C1N([Se]c2ccccc12)c1ccccc1

SMILES: O=C1N([Se]c2ccccc12)c1ccccc1
